business: Candidate Packs preserve explicit handling, meaning/application/assessment and source lineage without inferring semantics, authenticating standing or executing domain assessments. Parameter declarations must be explicit, closed and bounded. Every bound value needs a schema-valid exact source witness. Readiness and gaps remain bounded observations, not owner outcomes.
bridge: AlchLang owns handling classification, identity uniqueness, reference metadata selection, parameter-schema policy, contract identities, specialization/scope/provenance checks, assessment posture, successor checks, all Pack/report/manifest projections and readiness/gap decisions. Shared adapters only observe selected JSON/bytes, run generic structural validators, invoke exact native policies, encode selected projections and publish without overwrite.
system: Compose the native local capture with incremental native facts/projections. Preserve original request/capture/input bytes, keep original-file and selected-entry digests distinct, verify the completed frozen package before publication, and expose the existing CLI response envelope. No Python Define imports or copied runtime.
ordering: Capture closure, request coverage, native handling/meaning contracts, reference and application checks, assessment/selection/successor checks, native gaps/readiness, Pack/report structural validation, native manifest, frozen package verification, atomic publication.
scope: CLI preparation from current authoring sessions first. Compatibility entrypoints remain behind the deletion gate until caller and complete workflow audits pass.
